skillset.skill: 14s CT - 3000% Dark DMG (MAG). For 7s, heal allies' HP by 2%/s.
skillset.arts: 20000% Dark DMG (MAG). Increase allies' Arts by 20. For 20s, reduce enemies' Dark RES by 70%.
skillset.truearts: 85000% Dark DMG (MAG). 100% chance to inflict Paralysis for 5s. Increase own DMG against enemies with Status ailment(s) by 300% during True Arts.
skillset.superarts: 150000% Dark DMG (MAG). For 45s, increase allies' ATK and reduce enemies' MAG RES by 150%.

passive.ability1: Increase own DMG against enemies under 30% HP by 100%. Whilst the BGM is playing "Limbo", increase own Heal Amount by 20%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability2: Increase own Heal Amount by [1% × own ATK/100].
passive.ability3: When this unit takes lethal DMG, prevent HP from dropping below 1 HP for 3s and heal own HP by 100%. Ability can only be activated once per Quest.
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Yuyuko Saigyouji's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Yuyuko Saigyouji's SP. Art is owned)

trueweapon.name: Yuyuko's Fan
trueweapon.skill: 35s CT - 4000% Dark DMG (MAG). For 10s, reduce enemies' Paralysis RES by 50%.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Yuyuko, increase own ATK by 20% and Arts by 3/s. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
